name: How can I choose the right contractor for foreclosed property interior repair?

mainEntity.name: How can I choose the right contractor for foreclosed property interior repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor, look for experience with foreclosed or distressed properties, as they often present unique challenges. Check for proper licensing, insurance, and a strong portfolio of similar projects. Request detailed bids, review references, and ensure clear communication regarding scope, timeline, and budget. A contractor familiar with Bay Area building codes and property values can provide invaluable expertise.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor experienced with foreclosed properties, checking for licensing, insurance, references, clear communication, and detailed bids. Ensure they understand local codes.
